native_review.summary: The conversation successfully handled the user's request to return all items from a delivered order except the Espresso Machine. The agent authenticated the user via email, retrieved the order, listed the return details, obtained explicit confirmation, and processed the return using the original payment method. The user acted consistently with instructions and ended the conversation appropriately. The only issues were minor policy violations where the agent combined user-facing messages with tool calls in the same turn on two occasions, which did not affect the final outcome.

errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have either only made the tool call without sending a user-facing message, or only responded to the user without making the tool call in the same turn.
